reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the allowed downstream need records and assigns direct coverage only when an exact need string exists in the capabilities input; unsupported records remain visibly unsupported.

Root cause. prioritize_needs inverts unsupported semantics by setting unsupported to true when coverage == 'direct'. This ranks covered capabilities ahead of genuinely unsupported needs and feeds a contradictory priority table where direct coverage is labeled unsupported.

synthesize_recommendation retains the explicit eight-item priority window and deterministically derives the recommendation from the first already-ranked priority record. The bad recommendation is inherited from the upstream priority ordering, not introduced here.

select_demand_records mechanically selects every supplied corpus row because all demand_score values are at least 3. The supplied package does not include observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, or outcomes, so the market-demand strength of these records cannot be established beyond the provided scores.
normalize_evidence preserves the bounded allowed-record window, coerces numeric fields, applies neutral missing-field sentinels, and keeps the eight retained records visible for downstream handoff.
assemble_provenance builds ranked provenance records from normalized needs and the downstream handoff hashes show exact transfer of both needs and evidence_sources artifacts.
